correctness.rationale: The four boundary points outside the skein ball are paired by two arcs. Comparing that outside perfect matching with each of the three local perfect matchings exhausts all cases: equality gives two through-ball components and either unequal matching gives one. Thus the component counts are exactly \(\{c,c,c+1\}\). The localized-rank check is a separate consequence of exactness after scalar extension and the published rank \(2^{d-1}\).
